title: Known limitation: dense targeted flipping turns kNN sanitisation against the target class

invariants.description: Flipping 70 class-1 labels must still break ≥ 30% of correctly classified class-1 test samples.
Once flips are dense, neighbourhood majorities shift: sanitisation must not be reported as restoring the target class.
Sanitisation flags ≥ 10% of CLEAN labels here, relabelling genuine class-1 samples towards the attacker's label.

rationale: Documents that label sanitisation can make a targeted attack worse when the flipped fraction of a class is large.
